title: pixelhistory
description: Why one pixel is the colour it is: every event up to the scope event that tried to write it, the test that rejected each attempt, and the value before, from and after it. `readAs` says how the numbers in `color` were read -- the texture's own format, or --cast, or raw 32-bit words when the capture says neither.

eid.description: the scope: every write up to and including this event

marker.description: the marker path of the scope event, empty outside every marker

name.description: the capture's own name for the texture, or its id

slice.description: the array slice, the cube face, or the 3D slice at this mip

slices.description: how many slices this subresource has

cast.description: what --cast asked for, `typeless` when it was not given

readAs.description: how `color` is to be read: a component type, or `raw 32-bit words` when nothing in the capture says

usagesUpTo.description: how many events at or before the scope touch this texture, from the engine's own usage list: the evidence an empty `modifications` is read against

note.description: empty, or why a verdict in this document is not a closed case by itself: on D3D12 the `sample masked` test is an instrumented re-draw, so a flagged fragment can still carry a changed post value

marker.description: the marker path that event sits inside, empty outside every marker

fragIndex.description: which fragment of that event this was

passed.description: every test passed: this fragment wrote the pixel

reasons.description: the tests that rejected it, in the order `passed` reads them; empty when it passed

directShaderWrite.description: an arbitrary shader write (a UAV or a copy), not a draw's fragment

unboundPS.description: no usable pixel shader was bound at the event

valid.description: false when the engine marked the value invalid: the other three are then `-`

color.description: four components, comma separated, read as `readAs`

stencil.description: -1 not in use or unknown, -2 in use but unreadable

passed.description: how many of them wrote the pixel

shown.description: rows in `modifications`: total, or --max when there were more
